summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $1.79B+ accumulations in SPX 7000C contracts expiring in 2026. While there is significant hedging via SPX 8000P buys, the dominant conviction is seen in the multi-day persistent accumulation of SPX 7000C strikes (exps 2026-08 to 2026-12) totaling billions in premium. Conversely, extreme bearish sentiment is isolated to MSTR (P/C 13.10) and TSLA (P/C 2.67), suggesting localized hedging or heavy put selling/buying in those specific names. Traders should watch for SPX price action relative to the 7000 level and monitor if the massive NVDA BuyCall premium ($224.4M) translates into momentum or if the heavy SPY/TSLA put flow signals an imminent rotation into defensive sectors.
